entity.spawn.angler_fish.description: An menacing hunter found in deep waters, where it attracts smaller prey with its lure. Deflates on land. Fits in a bucket.
entity.spawn.tuna.description: An sizeable deep ocean fish that can be bred with most raw fish. Doesn't fit in a bucket when grown up.
entity.spawn.seahorse.description: An colorful, armored fish found in reefs and seagrass meadows. Comes in many shapes, sizes and colors based on where its found. Fits into a bucket.
entity.spawn.snail.description: A sluggish gastropod found in forests that produces mucus when wet. It has a shell that can be knocked off with projectiles and retreated into for protection. Besides meat, it'll eat just about anything.
entity.spawn.hamster.description: A cheeky rodent found in open grassy areas that can be tamed with sunflower seeds. It collects items and stores them in its cheek pouches, which can be accessed by its owner. Territorial and energetic, cannot withstand extreme temperatures.
entity.spawn.ant.description: A hardworking bug found in anthills. It brings resources to its home and helps decompose blocks. When hatched from an ant pupa it follows and protects its owner, also attacking other ants with different colored abdomens.
entity.spawn.sea_cow.description: A sea-faring mammal found in seagrass meadows that can be milked using a bucket. Grows seagrass on its back and eats tall seagrass, occasionally finding loot in it if fed before. Doesn't fit into a bucket when grown up. Drops leather.
entity.spawn.octopus.description: A curious mollusk rarely found in oceans. Can be captured in a multitude of items, including casting nets.
entity.spawn.herring.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in oceans schooling in big groups. Fits in a bucket.
entity.spawn.pilot_fish.description: An clingy fish that tends to be found circling bigger mobs. Fits in a bucket.
entity.spawn.blenny.description: A skittish, minute fish found in tide pools. Fits in a bucket.
entity.spawn.bluefish.description: An ravenous, schooling fish found in oceans and cold oceans. Can be thrown into a feeding frenzy if mobs nearby are hurt. Fits in a bucket.
entity.spawn.sunfish.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob that can be found in oceans. It basks during the day and swims near the bottom at night. Doesn't fit in a bucket when fully grown up. Eats tropical fish, herrings, and sea grass.
entity.spawn.barracuda.description: An predatory fish found in deep lukewarm and warm oceans. Can be caught in a casting net. Watch the teeth.
entity.spawn.coastal_crab.description: A neutral crustacean found in coastal regions that can shoot bubbles and bury itself. Investigating its nest may return something useful. Fits in a bucket.
entity.spawn.spider_crab.description: A hostile crustacean found in cold oceans. Can jump, climb walls, and shoot frozen bubbles.
entity.spawn.stranded.description: An abandoned iron golem that attacks hostiles that bump into it. Can be turned on and off by waxing.
entity.spawn.iguana.description: A spiny lizard found on tropical islands that can absorb sunrays and use them to cook items. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed. Likes dates.
entity.spawn.seal.description: A blubbery mammal found on lazing about cold islands and hunting in frozen oceans. Can hitch you a ride at the cost of live fish. Doesn't fit into a bucket when grown up.
entity.spawn.booby.description: A odd-looking bird found on sandy islands that performs mating dances and mates for life. Eats most fish.
entity.spawn.dodo.description: An ancient, defenseless bird found on rare islands that shoots harmless seeds at hostile mobs. It's incapable of breeding or swimming, and is oblivious to danger.
entity.spawn.clam.description: An patient mollusk mob found in oceans and beaches. Can be collected by hand and with a casting net.
entity.spawn.marine_iguana.description: A passive mob found on sea stacks. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed. Likes seagrass.
lore.spawn.coastal_crab_claw: A claw left in the sand by a coastal crab. Uses water to shoot bubbles that carry entities into the air.
lore.spawn.sunstone: A curious mineral charged with a cosmic warmth. Can be offered to a volcano to ignite its rage.
lore.spawn.moonstone: A curious mineral charged with a cosmic chill. Can be offered to a volcano to quell its rage.
